title: Sega Dreamcast
description: A disc's IP.BIN (at $0C008000) and its first program (1ST_READ.BIN at $0C010000, descrambled), one source for the SH-4 (source/sh2_writer) at physical addresses: IP.BIN's header field by field, flow from the bootstrap and the program's start, the Holly's, the buses', the Maple's, the GD-ROM's, the AICA's and the SH-4's registers by name, RAM, video and sound memory as var_ equates. The lane runs a disc of its own holding them, the program scrambled again when it was.

machine.container: disc image (.gdi with its track files, .cdi, .iso, .bin): IP.BIN and the first program
machine.toolchain: CodeBreaker's own assembler, or GNU as
